input: # Pre-release identifiers: numeric ones (all digits, no leading zero)
# become numbers; alphanumeric ones stay strings.
# An identifier that mixes digits and letters is alphanumeric, whichever
# Leading zeros are banned only for NUMERIC identifiers: an alphanumeric
# identifier may start with any number of zeros.
# The hyphen is an identifier character.
# A numeric identifier is numeric even next to alphanumeric ones.
# Words that are keywords elsewhere are plain identifiers here.
# Large numeric identifiers stay exact (up to 2^53 - 1 as a number).
# A hyphen after a dot-separated numeric run is still an identifier character.
